Definition
[Immortal almost hyperbolic piece] Source: chow-et-al-ricci-flow-part-iv:page-0237, chow-et-al-ricci-flow-part-iv:page-0238 ↗ def:chow-iv-cmc-boundary-conditions 1. ch33:33.4\group Hyperbolic pieces

For $A\in (0,\sqrt3/4]$ and $k\in \mathbb N$, an immortal $(A,k)$-almost hyperbolic piece is a smooth family $\mathcal M_A(t)$, $t\ge T$, together with a finite-volume hyperbolic manifold $(\mathcal H,h)$ and harmonic diffeomorphisms $F(t):\mathcal H_A\to \mathcal M_A(t)$ satisfying the CMC boundary conditions and \[ \| F(t)^*g(t)-h\| _{C^k(\mathcal H_A,h)}\le k^{-1} \quad (t\ge T). \]
